description: An oil-style painting of a man in a navy military coat with gold epaulettes, a black bicorn hat and white breeches, raising a light blue and white striped flag on a tall pole beside a wide river, with a second man in brown clothing helping at the pole. On the left, soldiers in blue and white uniforms stand in a line with muskets, a mounted officer sits on a brown horse, and a black cannon sits in the foreground under a dramatic stormy sky. No visible text, no frame, and the painting runs edge to edge.
